headline: Manchester City guilty charges explained: Premier League's options, how appeal works, more
description: Tuesday's news that the Premier League found Man City guilty of 100-plus charges of breaking financial rules is a landmark moment. But what comes next: what punishments are on the table, and how does the appeals process work?

headline: Downing Street clarifies Andy Burnham's remarks on Man City case
description: A spokesperson for Andy Burnham has insisted the guilty verdict against Manchester City is "serious" after remarks the Prime Minister made about the case on Wednesday raised eyebrows.

headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season

headline: Second Hull player flips car outside training ground - reports
description: A second Hull player has been reported to have flipped his car in an accident close to the club's training ground in Cottingham.

headline: Spain's Víctor Muñoz on Liverpool switch: Premier League more physical than LaLiga
description: Liverpool winger Víctor Muñoz has praised the "intensity" at the Premier League club since making the switch from LaLiga this summer, saying the change is "helping me grow" as a player.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid eye former Liverpool defender Quansah
description: Real Madrid are tracking Bayer Leverkusen defender Jarell Quansah ahead of next summer. Transfer Talk has the latest.
